newsitem.title: USA: MetLife acquires Hyatt Legal Plans.
newsitem.headline: MetLife acquires Hyatt Legal Plans.

text.p: Metropolitan Life Insurance Co said it acquired Hyatt Legal Plans Inc, the nation's largest provider of prepaid group legal plans.
The privately-held Cleveland, Ohio-based Hyatt will be operated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of MetLife under the umbrella of the company's Institutional Business Department.
Hyatt currently provides nearly one million people with access to an array of legal services, which are offered through a nationwide network of more than 6,800 attorneys.

MetLife said the voluntary, or employee-funded, segment of Hyatt's business is growing rapidly as employers search for ways to enhance the value of their employee benefits offerings without adding to their cost or administrative responsibilities.
